inspection: Retain and inspect every complete continuation, including failures. Token limits may leave an unfinished final sentence; score completed clauses. Core prompts assess short English narrative continuation; stress prompts separately expose domain limits and are not chatbot requirements.

acceptance.usable: Completed clauses are grammatical, follow the prompt, and avoid sustained loops, role/name swaps or clear contradictions within the continuation.
acceptance.limitations: This is a small manual screening set, not proof of general fluency. After selection, use a separate previously unseen confirmation set before promotion. Do not tune decoding to this set.
